scope: Independent source and semantic-test review. No large-board solving, training or strength claim performed by reviewer.
checks: Remaining margin converted to final P1 using current score and actual mover; loss/read conversion to mover occurs separately.
Raw and collapsed states replay independently and native forced-capture board identity is checked; retained captures do not flip perspective.
Unknown labels remain null; exact labels require exact status and integer parity/range; primary child-choice metrics require every legal child.
D4 edge mask plus mover-relative scores blocks semantic cross-split leakage, including physical color swaps; source families stay in one split.
State and query identities are source-game private; duplicate receipt stems fail instead of silently overwriting exact labels.
Frozen base inference uses eval/no_grad; calibration and structural heads share sampled family/root/state indices, optimizer schedule and CE target.
Child-order deltas pair common validation roots and bootstrap source families; complete held-out family coverage is explicit.
Known exclusion receipt is hashed and checked; unresolved actual GPU benchmark overlap remains provisional in both loader and report.
Controller uses compatible shared source locks and exclusive timed-opponent lock; worker process groups are reaped and partial exact receipts exported on interruption.
Both labeling phases use the full bounded session deadline; phase two visits one root per source game before the next band.

prepare.includes: Actual prepare.export to fit.run on exhaustive 2x2 labels; SIGTERM worker reaping; same-family separate-game ownership.

fit.includes: Frozen base/BN, exact child perspective, collapse/status tampering, incomplete-group exclusion, family bootstrap, cache reuse/corruption, provisional receipt scope.

queue.includes: Cross-process shared readers accepted, exclusive collection writer denied; bounded subprocess lifecycle and resume artifact integrity.

tests_reported_by_owners.lint_typing: Owners report Ruff and strict mypy clean; root owns final combined check.

limitations: Heads are diagnostic and are not production-compatible promoted checkpoints.
Actual GPU benchmark state exclusions remain pending.
Node-budget failures and wall-clock truncation produce conditional coverage; zero or few complete validation families cannot establish child-order improvement.
No evidence of improved strength until a fixed independent search/arena evaluation.
